answer: Yes, American Express was able to grow and retain its Card Members during 2022. Total cards-in-force increased to 133.3 million as of December 31, 2022, up from 121.7 million at the end of 2021 (a 10% increase). Additionally, proprietary cards-in-force rose to 76.7 million in 2022 from 71.4 million in 2021 (a 7% increase), and basic cards-in-force grew to 111.5 million from 100.7 million (an 11% increase).
rationale: The filing provides cards-in-force statistics showing growth in total, proprietary, and basic cards in 2022 compared to 2021, demonstrating strong retention and acquisition of card members.

grade.detail: The answer correctly confirms that American Express retained and grew its card member base in 2022, providing accurate supporting data from the 10-K filing.
